verdict.rationale: Ghostty has a public documentation site, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. Direct probes found no such thing: https://ghostty.org/llms.txt and https://ghostty.org/docs.md both return HTTP 404. Nothing else in the pack describes machine-readable or agent-oriented documentation; the `+show-config --docs` CLI output is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
